description.text:
Marketing Manager – Automotive Dealership
Location: Stockholm, Sweden Employment Type: Full-time
About the Role
We are looking for a creative, hands-on, and independent Marketing Manager to take overall responsibility for day-to-day marketing activities for two premium automotive brands in Stockholm.
You will manage the brands' digital presence, content creation, advertising, printed materials, and in-store events, ensuring a consistent and professional brand experience across all channels.
Key Responsibilities
Manage and develop social media channels across relevant platforms.


Plan, create, and publish engaging content for social media and digital channels.


Film and photograph vehicles, events, stores, and other marketing activities.


Edit videos, photos, graphics, and other marketing materials.


Manage digital advertising campaigns across websites and relevant platforms.


Coordinate the creation and production of printed marketing materials.


Plan, coordinate, and support events and promotional activities at dealerships.


Maintain consistent brand identity and visual communication across all channels.


Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, suppliers, and other marketing partners.


Monitor marketing activities and identify opportunities to improve engagement and brand visibility.


Take ownership of the day-to-day marketing calendar, activities, and deliverables for both brands.

Requirements
Experience in marketing, preferably within automotive, retail, premium/luxury, or consumer brands.


Strong understanding of social media marketing and digital content creation.


Practical experience with photography, video production, and editing.


Experience managing digital advertising and online campaigns.


Strong visual and creative sense with attention to brand consistency.


Ability to work independently and manage multiple activities simultaneously.


Strong communication, coordination, and organisational skills.


Fluency in English; Swedish is an advantage.


Comfortable working in a hands-on role where you are responsible for taking ideas from planning to execution.

What We Offer
An independent and hands-on marketing role within the automotive industry.


The opportunity to manage marketing activities for two premium automotive brands.


A dynamic and international working environment.


The opportunity to shape and develop the brands' local presence in the Swedish market.

description.text:
At Proposales, we’re transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We’re building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI.
We’re now taking the next step, expanding Proposales beyond proposals into booking, workflows and AI powered operations and we're looking for a Marketing Manager to lead how we tell our story and support the sales team in getting it out there. You'll run social content, plan events and help build the kind of presence that makes prospects already know who we are before a salesperson picks up the phone. This isn't a role where you hand off a brief and wait. You're hands on, from planning the campaign to shooting the video for it.  This role is Stockholm based - 100% on-site. 
Your mission:

Support sales through social content, events, and showing up in person where it matters


Run online marketing that builds both awareness and leads, not just one of the two


Use ABM to reach the accounts we actually want to win


Build our public presence and tell our story in a way people remember


Create visual content yourself, ads, videos, presentations, whatever the story needs


A bit about you:

3+ years in B2B SaaS marketing


Real experience with ABM, not just knowing the term


You've made content yourself, not just briefed someone else to do it


You move fast, you're confident, and you're not afraid to take a risk


You bring energy into a room


What we believe in:
We value ownership over process, curiosity over comfort, and getting things done over getting them perfect.
Our process:

First stage: An intro interview. We want to get to know you, and for you to get a feel for our culture and what Proposales is about.


Second stage: A meeting with our CEO. This is where you dig into the vision, and we talk through mutual expectations.


Third stage (Case Presentation): You'll get an assignment, then come into the office to meet some of your future colleagues and walk us through your case presentation.
